notes.title: Playtest is now Live!
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/xivtcieadds
Welcome to PIGFACE MASSACRE Playtest! You can now join Playtest using Request Acces button our game page and play & complete the First Chapter of game on Singleplayer mode.
Since this test is an early stage version of the game, you may encounter potential bugs. If you encounter any bugs during Playtest please report us on our Discord channel.

Thank you for playing, have fun!
